## recipe-546 — Field Veiled Bag
**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** public; Tailoring level 2; tier 1; Common; crafting DC 12; Standard quantity 2.
**Preserved source effect:** Creates a fitted container holding 10 pounds without counting against normal encumbrance; +1 to checks to conceal or organize its contents.

**Operational effect:** One output transforms one complete mundane body, retaining identity and latest lawful damage. Functional means current structural HP at least 1. While complete, functional, unsuppressed, unmelded and actually worn or directly held in its pouch-position position, relieve up to 10 lb of eligible real contents in stable loading order. Physical capacity is separately bounded by this model's weight, volume, opening and actual packing. Its own empty body is not relieved. Credit each covered record at most min(canonical Load, covered pounds/10), retaining actual mass and canonical Load. Inner containers cannot grant another relief; external lashings are not contents. The actual operator gains +1 only for the defined conceal-contents or organize-contents check using accessible functional unsuppressed fittings. This operator benefit does not require a relief slot and may assist an ally or thief at a table; it grants no ownership recognition. All qualifying Tailoring and Leatherworking task modifiers share equipment.leather-task-enhancement: use the strongest once per actual check. Each family's allowed domains remain distinct. Tailoring supplies no AC candidate, including zero, so it cannot cancel selected Crude armor. Ordinary actions, access, actual checks, tools and proficiency once still govern.

**Check domains:**
- Actual Bag operator's DEX check, with Sleight of Hand only if the task genuinely qualifies, to physically arrange real noncreature cargo using actual folds, lining or other cargo against ordinary inspection. No secret compartment or detection contest is created.
- Actual Bag operator's INT check for genuinely difficult sorting/packing of known accessible cargo, or DEX for difficult physical placement/separation. Respect fit, hazards, access, actions, hands and closures; no free retrieval, identification, preservation or extra contents.

| 1 | Clasps | 1 | 1 | binder | True | 0.1 | 2 | binder |

Nonconsumed source tools remain the same physical units, not consumed inputs, output mass, catalysts or ingredient-recovery copies. Their tier, role, amount, properties and function must be satisfied; a generic kit does not automatically supply an expensive source tool. All tool profiles have ordinary HP5 and actual declared material defenses. No Tailoring catalyst returns. Formula knowledge is not consumed even when a source Pattern component is.

**Work:** DEX; reviewed Weaver's-tools credential (Tailor's tools binding); Loom and Cutting Table; Tailor's tools, Needles, Shears. Source fieldCraftable=false controls even when timeMode=expedition. Source time 8 hours; activeWorkHours=8; operational active hours 8. First included stable phase 8 hours. Eligible Forge Dwarf: 360 whole active minutes, first phase 360 minutes. Maximum assistants 0. Stabilize only actually incorporated materials; replacement lots keep their own age. Actual workshop access, work phases, Watches and rest remain required.

Exact trivialAtSkillLevel=7; do not regenerate level+5. Untrained level-1–4 attempts retain source disadvantage with all physical requirements met. Preserve latest damage deficit, apply the strongest percentage to ordinary body HP and one flaw last. A functional damaged reserve can emerge Broken. Quality changes no potency, resistance, capacity, relief, grade or permission.

**Repair:** trained DEX + Weaver's-tools proficiency and actual Weaver's tools, using the Tailor's-tools binding; an actual Loom and Cutting Table; and the required Needles and Shears. The same actual implement may meet compatible overlapping requirements without duplicate purchases. Missing the actual toolkit prevents starting either route; a quotation alone grants no permission. Functional HP≥1: DC10, max(1 hour, recorded max HP/10), materials 25% actual undamaged mundane body reference. Broken HP0: DC12, max(8 hours, recorded max HP/10), materials 25% undamaged finished unit reference; recoverable original main body required, including both original Gloves members or the required original outfit constituents. Binary success restores recorded maximum and dormant imprint usability subject to suppression; failure consumes work/materials. No formula or original trade level, XP, quality, catalyst return or Forge Dwarf reduction; original rare creation-tool rows are not extra generic repair requirements. Preserve identity, fit, model, size, grade, durability and flaw. Repair returns no lost contents.
